scope: 80 real engine outputs; no private customer conversations.
method: Provisional linguistic analysis by the coding assistant. No human bilingual validation has been completed. Observed absence of an issue is not certification.

severityRubric.critical: Corrupts an actionable destination or identifier and can misdirect an operation.
severityRubric.major: Changes a participant, deadline, warranty condition, instruction or explicit currency.
severityRubric.moderate: Loses useful meaning, uses unclear business terminology or violates required formal register.
severityRubric.minor: Grammar, naturalness or courtesy issue with broadly recoverable meaning.
severityRubric.none_observed: No issue observed in this fixture; human validation remains pending.

longStressFindings.observation: El pasaje repetido nueve veces se comprime y altera. Introduce 'Your request will be closed by email 12345', que no existe en la entrada.
Omite repeticiones, cambia 'Do not cancel' por 'No cancelaremos' y anade 'Su solicitud no sera completada', una negacion no presente en la entrada.

results.observedOutput: Good morning. How can I help you today?
Good afternoon, thank you for contacting with support.

findings.observation: La preposicion 'contacting with support' es poco natural; el destinatario de soporte se conserva.

results.observedOutput: Can I have your order number, please?
I need to confirm his delivery address.

findings.observation: 'su direccion' se convierte en 'his delivery address'; se atribuye la direccion a un tercero.

results.observedOutput: Your request has been properly processed.
Do you wish to receive an invoice by email?

findings.observation: 'la factura' pasa a 'an invoice'; cambia la especificidad.

results.observedOutput: Yes, the product's available at this time.
Do not cancel order 12345.
We haven't been paid yet.

findings.observation: 'We haven't been paid' omite la referencia explicita al pago del cliente.

results.observedOutput: We'll never ask for his password by phone.

findings.observation: 'su contrasena' pasa a 'his password'; cambia el referente de una instruccion de seguridad.

results.observedOutput: The delivery's scheduled for November 15th 2026.
Your date is 03 / 04 / 2026 and confirm if you mean 3 April.

findings.observation: 'cita' se traduce como 'date', ambiguo; el token de fecha se separa con espacios. La peticion de aclarar abril se conserva.

results.automatedFlagDisposition: Date separator spacing triggers exact-token warning; ambiguity is intentionally retained for confirmation.

results.observedOutput: We attend from 9: 00 to 17: 30, Monday to Friday.

findings.observation: 'We attend' es un calco para el horario de atencion. Los espacios y cero inicial cambian, pero las horas siguen siendo 09:00 y 17:30.

results.automatedFlagDisposition: Hours retain their value; exact formatting changed.

results.observedOutput: The total price is USD 49.95, including taxes.
Reimbursement shall be EUR 25 and not EUR 250.

findings.observation: 'shall' introduce un registro contractual poco natural para atencion al cliente; cantidades y negacion conservadas.

results.observedOutput: Your order AB-009871 will come tomorrow.
The engineer María López will review his case.

findings.observation: 'su caso' pasa a 'his case'; el referente del cliente cambia.

results.observedOutput: Please send the documents to support @ example.com.

findings.observation: La direccion soporte@example.com cambia a support @ example.com. Traduce el identificador y lo fragmenta; no es un destino fiable.

results.observedOutput: Reboot SQL server after saving settings.

findings.observation: Omite el articulo en 'Reboot SQL server'; instruccion tecnica conservada.

results.observedOutput: The VPN connection requires authentication of two factors.

findings.observation: 'authentication of two factors' es comprensible pero no es la expresion tecnica usual 'two-factor authentication'.

results.observedOutput: We should be grateful if you would have a copy of the invoice attached.

findings.observation: 'would have a copy ... attached' resulta forzado y puede dificultar la solicitud de adjuntar la factura.

results.observedOutput: Would you be so kind as to have a moment while I check information?

findings.observation: 'have a moment' no expresa con claridad la instruccion de esperar; conserva una formula cortes.

results.observedOutput: The charge appears double in my account.

findings.observation: 'appears double in my account' es poco natural para un cargo duplicado.

results.observedOutput: I'm going to the bank to check the payment.
My account's been blocked and I can't get in.
Yesterday I called and they told me that the dispatch's out.

findings.observation: 'the dispatch's out' es una formulacion poco natural para un envio que ya salio.

results.observedOutput: I don't want a replacement. I want a refund.
If the package doesn't come by Friday, contact us again.

findings.observation: 'antes del viernes' pasa a 'by Friday', que puede incluir el viernes; altera el limite temporal.

results.observedOutput: Confirm 3 units from model X200 and 2 from model X300.

findings.observation: 'units from model' es menos natural que 'units of model'; modelos y cantidades conservados.

results.observedOutput: The discount is 15% but does not apply to sending.

findings.observation: 'envio' pasa a 'sending'; no identifica con claridad el coste de transporte.

results.observedOutput: The payment was rejected, but did not approve.

findings.observation: 'but did not approve' introduce una clausula sin sujeto claro; no equivale a la formulacion pasiva 'not approved'.

results.observedOutput: The outstanding balance is USD 0.
The monitoring number is ZX987654310EN.

findings.observation: ZX987654321ES se convierte en ZX987654310EN; cambia digitos y sufijo. 'monitoring number' tampoco es la denominacion de seguimiento.

results.observedOutput: Mrs. Ana Pérez can pick up the package with her ID.
Do not share code 004812 with anyone.
Can you confirm that you received both attachments?
The guarantee cover parts but excludes water damage.

findings.observation: 'The guarantee cover parts' tiene un error de concordancia; se mantiene la exclusion por agua.

results.observedOutput: Let's scale up the incidence to the technical team.

findings.observation: 'scale up the incidence' no expresa derivar o escalar una incidencia al soporte tecnico.

results.observedOutput: Thank you for your patience. We'll report back to you after the review.
The client said, "I did not authorize that $80 charge."

findings.observation: USD se sustituye por '$'; conserva 80, pero el simbolo es ambiguo entre monedas denominadas dolar.

results.observedOutput: Buenos días. ¿Cómo puedo ayudarle hoy?
Buenas tardes, gracias por contactar con el cliente.

findings.observation: 'customer support' pasa a 'el cliente'; cambia el destinatario del contacto.

results.observedOutput: ¿Podría confirmar su número de pedido?

findings.observation: Omite 'please'. Mantiene la cortesia condicional de 'Podria'.

results.observedOutput: Necesito verificar tu dirección de entrega.

findings.observation: Usa 'tu direccion' en un corpus de atencion formal que pide tratamiento de usted.

results.observedOutput: Su solicitud ha sido procesada con éxito.
¿Le gustaría que le enviara la factura?

findings.observation: Omite el canal de correo electronico y cambia 'us' por un emisor singular.
